messages:
maria: Heads-up: renaming proto key `route_priority` -> `priority_hint` caused some clients to hit 409 on config apply this morning.
dan: Got alerts. How bad?
maria: ~2% of apply calls failing. Example:
```http
POST /v1/runtime/apply
{
  "route_priority":"high"
}
HTTP/1.1 409 {"error":"field mismatch","field":"route_priority"}
```
nisha: Preview/diff endpoints too?
maria: Yes. Can revert but better to support compatibility short-term.
kevin: Two choices: gateway rewrite vs server-side transform. Gateway is faster to patch; server-side is auditable and single source of truth.
julie: If server-side transform, emit metric `compat.accepted_old_field` and keep feature-flagged so we can ramp safely.
maria: Plan: add transform in reconcile service behind ff.runtime.accept_old_priority, deploy canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%, keep on for 14d then announce removal window. Also normalize aliases in preview diff to avoid churn.
dan: Console should show a non-blocking banner when it posts deprecated field and include telemetry `used_deprecated_field:true` on config.submit.
nisha: I'll add banner + telemetry and an e2e asserting telemetry appears.
kevin: Make sure transform is identity: no semantic change. If enums change, this is riskier.
maria: It's a pure key rename; enums unchanged.
julie: Dashboards to track: timeseries `compat.accepted_old_field` per-account, percent of applies needing transform, diff-churn pre/post. Alert if transforms >1%/hr or if apply errors increase. Auto-suspend shim if transform rate spikes and errors rise above threshold.
maria: PR incoming with transform, flag, preview normalization. Will open console PR later.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: reconcile v2 canary deployed (sha a1b2c3).
kevin: Also add reconciliation comparator that treats aliases as equal so customers don't see spurious diffs.
maria: Yup, included in tests.
dan: Agree server-side approach. Keep strict 409 until we have shim+metrics.
julie: I'll draft ops runbook and customer comms for deprecation.
maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood/reconcile/pull/421. Thanks all :thumbsup:
